context: Mei and Aoi chat over coffee.
purpose: Casual register; adverbs/daily (どうも/いれ/ところで/メガネ/おいしい) in natural home.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: このケーキ、すごくおいしいね。
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle delighted delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 砂糖を少し入れすぎたかも。
lines.en: I might have put in a bit too much sugar.
lines.style: bright barista voice, soft warm sheepish delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ううん、どうも甘さがちょうどいいよ。
lines.en: No, the sweetness is somehow just right.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm reassuring delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ところで、新しいメガネにしたの?
lines.en: By the way, did you get new glasses?
lines.style: curious barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: うん、メガネを変えてみたの。
lines.style: soft woman voice, gentle warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: どうも、その方が似合ってるよ。
lines.style: warm barista voice, soft warm complimentary delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ありがとう。コーヒー、もう一杯入れてくれる?
lines.en: Thanks. Could you pour me another coffee?
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: もちろん!おいしいの、入れるね。
lines.en: Of course! I'll make a tasty one.
lines.style: cheerful barista voice, soft warm bubbly closing delivery throughout
